topic: Write a Page in a Wellness Book(为班级健康手册写一页)
genre: 记叙/说明文(describe a positive change in health and fitness)
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 3 Reading for Writing:write a page in a wellness book(对比过去与现在,描述自己在健康/健身上的积极改变)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,你们班有一本'健康手册',同学们在里面分享健康与健身的心得。请用英语写一页(约80词),描述你在运动或饮食上的一个积极改变,内容包括:① 你过去的问题或习惯;② 你做了什么改变;③ 改变带来的结果;④ 给同学的一条建议。注意用表示对比的词(instead of, rather than, now…)。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your class keeps a wellness book where students share ideas about health and fitness. Write a page (about 80 words) describing one positive change you have made in exercise or eating, including: 1) your problem or habit in the past; 2) what change you made; 3) the result of the change; 4) one piece of advice for your classmates. Use words that show contrast (instead of, rather than, now…).
points: 过去的问题/习惯(I used to … / In the past, I worried about …)
做出的改变(Instead of …, I … / Rather than …, I started …)
结果(Now I feel … / I have become both happier and healthier)
给同学的建议(My advice is … / Why not …?)
model_essay: In the past, I worried about my weight all the time and tried every new diet I read about online. Then I decided to think about fitness rather than weight. Instead of cutting out the foods I enjoyed, I added healthy foods to my meals, and I started jogging for half an hour every morning. Now I feel both happier and healthier, and I have much more energy at school. My advice is simple: choose a sport you enjoy and train a little every day. Stay positive, and your body will thank you!
model_translation: 过去我整天担心体重,试遍了网上看到的每一种减肥法。后来我决定多想健康,而不是体重。我没有戒掉爱吃的食物,而是往三餐里加了健康食物,还开始每天早晨慢跑半小时。现在我更快乐也更健康,在学校精力充沛得多。我的建议很简单:选一项你喜欢的运动,每天练一点。保持积极,你的身体会感谢你!

rubric.criteria: 四要素齐全:过去问题 / 做的改变 / 结果 / 建议
过去—现在对比清晰,用 instead of / rather than / now 等连接,行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样,过去与现在时态正确,语法基本无误

required_structure: 过去 In the past, I … / I used to …
改变 Instead of … / Rather than …, I started …
结果 Now I feel both happier and healthier
建议 My advice is … / Why not …?
key_expressions: In the past, I worried about my weight all the time.
I decided to think about fitness rather than weight.
Instead of cutting out the foods I enjoyed, I added healthy foods.
Now I feel both happier and healthier.
Choose a sport you enjoy and train a little every day.

high_sentences: I decided to think about fitness rather than weight.
Instead of cutting out the foods I enjoyed, I added healthy foods to my meals.
Now I feel both happier and healthier, and I have much more energy.
Choose a sport you enjoy and train a little every day.

error_pairs.wrong: In the past I am worried about my weight.
error_pairs.correct: In the past I worried about my weight.
error_pairs.note: 叙述过去的状态用一般过去时 worried。

error_pairs.wrong: Instead of cut out the foods, I added healthy foods.
error_pairs.correct: Instead of cutting out the foods, I added healthy foods.
error_pairs.note: instead of 后接动名词 cutting。

error_pairs.wrong: Now I become both happier and healthier.
error_pairs.correct: Now I have become both happier and healthier.
error_pairs.note: 表示从过去到现在的变化用现在完成时 have become。

paragraph_template:
【健康手册一页结构】
第1步 过去:In the past, I … / I used to …
第2步 改变:Instead of … , I … / Rather than … , I started …
第3步 结果:Now I feel both happier and healthier …
第4步 建议+收尾:My advice is … / Why not …? Stay positive!
